ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Class sessions will be held on the following Tuesdays: Oct 2 and 30, Nov 6 and 13. Tuesday sessions will be held from 5:30-8:30pm CST. This section is restricted to the EOL Oak Brook SELP (Ed Admin) Doctoral cohort that began in Summer 2010. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDD:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
